name: Elekta AB (publ)
summary: Elekta AB (publ), a medical technology company, provides clinical solutions for treating cancer and brain disorders in the Americas, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and the Asia Pacific. The company offers linear machines and radiation therapy products comprising Elekta Unity for anatomy-specific MR imaging; Elekta Evo, a CT-Linac solution; Elekta Versa HD, a brain metastases solution; Elekta Harmony; and Elekta Infinity for treating a range of patients with simple-to-complex radiotherapy needs, as well as quality assurance, and treatment and motion management solutions.
